The '''Giblim Route''' was a [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade route]] that went from the [[Caluula system/Legends|Caluula system]] in the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]] to the [[Minntooine system/Legends|Minntooine system]] in the [[Calamari sector/Legends|Calamari sector]]. It passed near to [[New Alderaan/Legends|New Alderaan]].<ref name="TEAOC" />
